title: Privileged container
message: Privileged containers have full access to the node.

title: Kubernetes Secret with data in the repository
message: Secret values are only base64-encoded; use a secret manager or sealed secrets. Values are never copied to the report.

title: Possible hard-coded credential in configuration
message: Value is never copied to the report; check location and rotate if real.
